info.text:
Marriott owned or leased just 51 of its 9,805 properties at the end of 2025.
The rest are owned by others who pay Marriott franchise, base management and incentive management fees.
Gross fee revenue hit $5.44 billion in 2025, up from $2.69 billion in 2021.
Co-branded credit card fees alone were $716 million in 2025.
$19.2 billion of its $26.19 billion 2025 revenue was cost reimbursements that mostly pass through.
Sources: Marriott 2025 Form 10-K and fourth quarter 2025 results (Feb 10, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
